title: Knowledge / runbook retrieval with citation
input: What checks does the account-lockout runbook RB-LOCK-01 require? Account lockout runbook checks required verify AD lockoutTime.

corpus.text: What checks does the account-lockout runbook RB-LOCK-01 require? Account lockout runbook checks required are verify AD lockoutTime attribute, confirm failed logon count threshold, check password expiry status, and review recent helpdesk tickets for the user before unlocking.
